name: Scripted desktop
description: A small desk with icons, draggable windows, a taskbar and an assistant whose fake pointer tidies the icons, opens captures, empties the bin and spins a turntable on request.

propDocs.brandForm: First half of the two-tone product name shown in the desk window title and on the fake pointer tag.
propDocs.brandSuffix: Second half of the two-tone product name, drawn in the accent colour.
propDocs.accent: Accent colour for the pointer ring, focus outlines, badge and equaliser. Defaults to the section tint.
propDocs.strings: Object that overrides any label: layers, captures, turntable, exports, bin, layersAria, capturesAria, turntableAria, exportsAria, binFullAria, binEmptyAria, badge, deskTitle, assistantLabel, minimise, maximise, close, conversation, askLabel, askPlaceholder, send, suggestionsLabel, start, taskDesk, taskCaptures, taskTurntable, capturesTitle, turntableTitle, playLabel, trackTitle, trackSub, frameLabel, discAlt. Missing keys keep the English default.
propDocs.replies: Object that overrides any assistant line: hello, tidyStart, tidyDone, picsStart, picsDone, binEmpty, binAlready, musicStart, musicDone, resetDone, other, layersOnly, exportsOnly. Missing keys keep the English default.
propDocs.suggestions: Array of {label, intent} with intent one of tidy, pics, bin, music, reset. An empty array keeps the four defaults.
propDocs.patterns: Object of intent name to a regular expression source, matched case insensitively against typed text. Missing keys keep the English patterns for tidy, pics, bin, music and reset.
propDocs.media: Object with capturesIconDark, capturesIconLight, capturesIconW, capturesIconH, knot, knotW, knotH, knotAlt and thumbs, an array of {dark, light, alt, altLight, origin, w, h} for the three captures. Missing keys keep the defaults.

fallback: The poster shows the desk at rest. Under reduced motion the desk works the same but every script step runs at once and the loops and transitions are switched off.
